name: SpinCell 3N
summary: Compact 3-part differential hematology analyzer running up to 72 samples per hour from just 8.5 µL of whole blood. Reports 22 parameters with 3 histograms using only two reagents, with a 10.4" colour screen, built-in thermal printer and HL7 LIS/HIS connectivity.

specs.label: WBC & differential
specs.value: WBC, LYM#, MID#, GRAN#, LYM%, MID%, GRAN%

specs.label: RBC
specs.value: RBC, HGB, HCT, MCV, MCH, MCHC, RDW-CV, RDW-SD

specs.label: Platelets
specs.value: PLT, MPV, PDW-SD, PDW-CV, P-LCR, P-LCC, PCT

specs.label: Sample volume
specs.value: 8.5 µL whole blood mode, 20 µL pre-dilute mode

specs.label: Reagents
specs.value: 2: diluent and lyse (lyse stored inside the analyzer)

specs.label: Data storage
specs.value: Up to 1,000,000 sample results with histograms

specs.label: Quality control
specs.value: L-J, X, X-R, X-B control modes; manual and automatic calibration

specs.label: Ports
specs.value: RS-232, Ethernet, 8 × USB (mouse, keyboard, external printer)

specs.label: Controls
specs.value: CBC-3D normal (3 × 2 mL, 6 × 2 mL) or 3 levels (3 × 2 mL, 6 × 2 mL)

features: Micro sample volume: 8.5 µL in whole blood mode
Only 2 reagents, with lyse stored inside the analyzer
Automatic internal and external cleaning of the aspiration probe
Internal diluent preheating for accurate results
Auto clog removal by aperture cauterizing and flushing
LIS and HIS connection with HL7 protocol
Openable side door for easy maintenance
